training_lineage_contract: walkcurr rl_only (tracks.json): no gait clock, no BC teacher, no motion prior, no AMP/demo reward anywhere in this lineage. This checkpoint is a warm-start chain of plain --init-from-source continuations off the mesh_mjx 50Hz currentcap29 base (task-reward/curriculum/optimizer-stability levers only: goal.joint_action_bias_* centering, --kl-rollback=0.05, --actor-lr/--critic-lr=1e-4, train.hold_grace_curriculum) -- no demonstration data, teacher action target, or scripted motion role enters this lineage at any point. See CURRENT_TRUTHS.md 2026-09-17 rise-flat+hold consolidation entries and rl_docs/tracks/walkcurr/STATUS.md 09-16/09-17 currentcap29 thread.

no_lower_or_walk_role_in_this_bundle: This candidate is the STANCE role only (rise-from-floor + hold-standing). It has NO lower/sit-down capability (the walkcurr LOWER floor is CLOSED -- all 16 agent-doable RL mechanism classes refuted as of 2026-09-17, parked on Robot Lab achievability review, CURRENT_TRUTHS.md) and NO walk role of its own (the separately-trained rl_only WALK role lives in bundle_rlonly_v2 and is NOT composed with this checkpoint's weights -- these are two independently trained clean-RL roles per RL_GOALS.md's explicit allowance for role composition over a monolithic actor). Do not read this manifest as a sit-to-walk-to-sit bundle. A physical trial needs either a manual/gantry start into the rise_flat initial pose, or a separate composition step (untried) chaining this role with bundle_rlonly_v2's walk role and a scripted/manual lower.
transfer_blockers_or_work: LOWER IS MISSING: this role cannot sit back down under its own policy. Any physical trial must end each attempt with a manual/gantry catch or a scripted lower, not this policy.

WALK IS SEPARATE: composing this stance role with bundle_rlonly_v2's walk role (same rl_only parent goal, different checkpoints/lineages) has not been attempted -- the two were trained on different goal-mixes/reward stacks (this one never sees goal.walk_*, the walk role never sees goal.rise_*/hold_*) and a handoff transition (rise-done pose -> walk-ready pose) has not been built or tested. This is the concrete next step toward a fuller rl_only lifecycle demo, not yet built.

PHYSICAL SAFETY: exported with the SAFE 50Hz motor contract (bus_write_speed=400/write_acc=20/max_delta_q_deg=0.75, matching bundle_50hz_v1) -- still requires Robot Lab's independent preflight/derate before any motion, same as every other exported policy on this project.

SEED GENERALIZATION: 2/3 independently-trained seeds (s3, s5) consolidate rise-flat+hold at the full 15M-step budget under this exact recipe with LARGE, reproducible margins (10/12 and 12/12+12/12). The third (s1) is CLOSED as a per-seed outlier, not a fixable in-training regression: a concurrent 2026-09-17 ~11:0x investigation (new tool `rl_move/sim/probe_currentcap29_flatonly.py`, corrected-physics re-eval of 5 intermediate snapshots) found s1 sits persistently near-zero/marginal for essentially its entire continuation (not declining from a good mid-run state as the original FAIL-MECHANISM verdict's own probe implied), with GPU/MJX run-to-run float non-determinism flipping some borderline episode counts near the pass/fail boundary. A separate same-day read of s1's raw training-time reward-term curves (this cycle) additionally shows a real but smaller, corroborating anti-correlation between `env/max_current_a` (creeping 1.27A->1.58A over steps 9-13M) and `env/reward_task` (0.27->0.21) -- consistent with, not contradicting, the 'persistently marginal, not cleanly consolidating' characterization. s1 is NOT part of this bundle and per the 11:0x verdict is not being chased further absent a genuinely new mechanism idea. See walkcurr STATUS.md 2026-09-17 ~11:0x/this entry for the full read.
